scenarios.title: A｜选择套餐
scenarios.setting: 玩家刚到当地，来到手机营业厅购买 SIM 卡。

turns.text: Hi. What can I help you with?

turns.prompt: 关于「购买」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to get a SIM card, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to get a SIM card, please.
feedback.explanation: “SIM card”指手机 SIM 卡，区别于泛指充值卡的说法。

choices.text: I’m looking for a prepaid SIM card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m looking for a prepaid SIM card.
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: I need a SIM card for about a month. What options do you have?

feedback.naturalExpression: I need a SIM card for about a month. What options do you have?
feedback.explanation: “what options”询问可选方案，便于在了解条件后作决定。

choices.text: Do you have any plans for short-term visitors?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any plans for short-term visitors?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: I want to buy a phone card.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to get a SIM card, please.
feedback.explanation: “phone card”可能指充值或通话卡；需要装进手机的卡应明确说“SIM card”。

turns.text: Sure. How long are you planning to use it for?

turns.prompt: 关于「购买」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ll be here for about three months.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll be here for about three months.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Just two weeks. I’m here on vacation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just two weeks. I’m here on vacation.
feedback.explanation: “on vacation”表示正在度假，适合说明行程目的或最近的安排。

choices.text: I’m staying here long-term, so I’d like a monthly plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m staying here long-term, so I’d like a monthly plan.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’m not sure yet. Can I renew the plan later?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure yet. Can I renew the plan later?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: We have a few prepaid and monthly options.

turns.prompt: 你想根据自己的使用习惯比较手机套餐，会怎么说？

choices.text: What’s the difference between these two plans?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the difference between these two plans?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Which one would be better if I mostly use mobile data?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which one would be better if I mostly use mobile data?
feedback.explanation: “I mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: Does either plan include calls and texts?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does either plan include calls and texts?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Can I cancel the monthly plan anytime?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I cancel the monthly plan anytime?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

scenarios.title: B｜询问流量
scenarios.setting: 在“购买 SIM 卡”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问流量”。

turns.text: This plan comes with 20 gigabytes of data per month.

turns.prompt: 你想确认流量套餐的额度和用完后的安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is 20 gigabytes the total amount for the month?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is 20 gigabytes the total amount for the month?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: What happens if I use all the data?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens if I use all the data?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: Can I buy extra data if I run out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I buy extra data if I run out?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Does unused data carry over to the next month?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does unused data carry over to the next month?
feedback.explanation: “carry over”表示结转到下一个周期，适合确认未用完的流量或额度是否保留。

choices.text: How many internet does this plan have?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is 20 gigabytes the total amount for the month?
feedback.explanation: 套餐流量叫“data”，通常不可数；问“How much data does this plan include?”，不用“How many internet”。

turns.text: If you use it all, you can purchase additional data.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much does extra data cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much does extra data cost?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Can I check how much data I have left?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check how much data I have left?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Does this plan include 5G?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this plan include 5G?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Can I use the data for a mobile hotspot?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I use the data for a mobile hotspot?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: Yes, you can use it as a hotspot.

turns.prompt: 你想根据自己的用量选择流量方案，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I think 20 gigabytes should be enough for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I think 20 gigabytes should be enough for me.
feedback.explanation: “should be enough”表示数量或程度已经足够，能让对方知道无需再增加。

choices.text: Okay. In that case, I’d like this plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. In that case, I’d like this plan.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

scenarios.title: C｜完成开通
scenarios.setting: 在“购买 SIM 卡”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“完成开通”。

turns.text: All right. I’ll need to activate the SIM card for you.

turns.prompt: 你想确认开通手机服务需要哪些材料或手续，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you need my passport or any other ID?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you need my passport or any other ID?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to fill out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to fill out?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: How long does activation usually take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long does activation usually take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Can I start using it immediately after it’s activated?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I start using it immediately after it’s activated?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: Once it’s activated, put the SIM card in your phone and restart it.

turns.prompt: 你想了解开通后怎样查号码或设置手机，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will my phone number be on the package?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will my phone number be on the package?
feedback.explanation: “phone number”指电话号码，区别于手机本身。

choices.text: Do I need to change any settings on my phone?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to change any settings on my phone?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: How can I check my balance and remaining data?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I check my balance and remaining data?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Is there an app I can use to manage the plan?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an app I can use to manage the plan?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.text: Yes. You can use our app to check your usage and top up your account.

turns.prompt: 你想了解怎样给手机账户充值，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. How do I top it up?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How do I top it up?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Can I use a foreign credit card in the app?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I use a foreign credit card in the app?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Great. Could you help me make sure it’s working before I leave?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you help me make sure it’s working before I leave?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: Of course. Let’s test the connection now.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s working now. Thank you!

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s working now. Thank you!
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great, I have a signal now. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, I have a signal now. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: “signal”指信号，手机情景中可用它描述能否连接网络。
